description: Modular objective placement templates. Copy and adapt per-field.

corner_quad.name: Four Corners
corner_quad.placement_rule: Place at 25% and 75% along each diagonal from corners
corner_quad.visibility: Each objective should have line-of-sight to at least one other

central_arena.name: Central Arena
central_arena.placement_rule: Dead center of field, elevated if possible
central_arena.visibility: Visible from all angles, hardest to hold

helicopter_extraction.name: Helicopter Extraction
helicopter_extraction.placement_rule: One inside helo, one under tail, one in nearest structure
helicopter_extraction.visibility: Varied — one hard, one medium, one easy
